subject: BAR
title: Sales-Type Lease and Sale and Leaseback — Meridian Industrial Systems
scenario:
You are the senior accountant for Meridian Industrial Systems, Inc. ("Meridian"), a calendar-year public company that manufactures material-handling equipment and both sells and leases that equipment to customers. Two transactions must be accounted for in the year ended December 31, Year 1.

On January 1, Year 1, Meridian delivered a newly manufactured sorting system to Calder Foods, Inc. under the lease summarized in **Exhibit 2**. Meridian's background information and accounting policies are in **Exhibit 1**, and the present value factors Meridian uses are in **Exhibit 3**.

On July 1, Year 1, Meridian sold its Fairview distribution warehouse to Northgate Capital Partners and immediately leased the warehouse back. The terms of that transaction are in **Exhibit 4**.

Complete each work tab using the exhibits. Round all amounts to the nearest whole dollar.

exhibits.title: Exhibit 1: Memorandum — Background and Accounting Policies
exhibits.content:
**To:** Accounting staff
**From:** Controller, Meridian Industrial Systems, Inc.
**Subject:** Year 1 lease matters

- Meridian manufactures material-handling equipment. Equipment built for customers is carried in inventory at manufacturing cost until it is delivered, whether the customer buys the equipment outright or leases it.
- In applying the lease classification criteria, Meridian follows the guidance in ASC 842-10-55-2 and treats a lease term of 75% or more of the remaining economic life as a "major part" of that life, and a present value of 90% or more of fair value as "substantially all" of that fair value.
- Collection of the lease payments due from Calder Foods, including any amount owed under the residual value guarantee, is probable.
- Meridian incurred no initial direct costs in connection with either of the Year 1 transactions.
- Meridian leases its corporate headquarters from an unrelated landlord under an operating lease requiring monthly payments of $18,000 through December Year 4.
- Meridian's weighted average cost of capital, used for capital budgeting, is 9.5%.
- Buildings are depreciated on a straight-line basis over 40 years with no residual value.

tasks.title: Net Investment in the Lease at Commencement
tasks.instruction: Using **Exhibit 2** and the present value factors in **Exhibit 3**, calculate the net investment in the lease that Meridian records on January 1, Year 1, measured immediately before the first lease payment is received. Enter the amount in whole dollars, no commas.
tasks.explanation: For a lessor, lease payments include the fixed payments and the full amount of any residual value guarantee provided by the lessee. The six annual payments of $80,000 are due at the beginning of each lease year, so they are discounted at 8% using the present value of an annuity due factor for six periods: $80,000 x 4.99271 = $399,417. The $30,000 residual value guaranteed by Calder Foods is a single amount received at the end of year 6: $30,000 x 0.63017 = $18,905. Because the entire $30,000 estimated residual value is guaranteed, there is no unguaranteed residual asset to add. Net investment in the lease = $399,417 + $18,905 = $418,322.
tasks.explanationJa:
貸手のリース料には、固定のリース料に加えて**借手が提供する残存価額保証の全額**が含まれる（借手側で「支払うと見込まれる額」だけを含めるのとは扱いが異なる点に注意）。

1. リース料の現在価値: 年額 $80,000 は各年の**期首払い**なので、8%・6期の年金現価係数（期首払い）4.99271 を使う。
   $80,000 × 4.99271 = **$399,417**
2. 保証残存価額の現在価値: $30,000 は6年後に一括で受け取るため、複利現価係数 0.63017 を使う。
   $30,000 × 0.63017 = **$18,905**
3. 見積残存価額 $30,000 は全額が保証されているため、無保証残存資産（unguaranteed residual asset）はゼロ。
4. 正味リース投資未回収額 = $399,417 + $18,905 = **$418,322**

tasks.title: Lease Classification
tasks.instruction: Based on **Exhibit 1** and **Exhibit 2**, select the classification Meridian must use for the Calder Foods lease.
tasks.explanation: A lessor classifies a lease as a sales-type lease if any one of the five classification criteria is met. Two of them are met here. The six-year lease term is 75% of the sorting system's eight-year remaining economic life, which Meridian treats as a major part of that life. In addition, the $418,322 present value of the lease payments and the guaranteed residual value is 99.6% of the $420,000 fair value of the sorting system, which is substantially all of that fair value. Direct financing treatment applies only when none of the five criteria is met but collection is probable and the present value of the lease payments plus a residual value guaranteed by a party other than the lessee is substantially all of the fair value; here the guarantee comes from the lessee and the criteria are met, so that treatment does not apply. Operating lease treatment is likewise unavailable once a criterion is met, and the six-year term is far longer than the 12 months that a short-term lease requires.
tasks.explanationJa:
貸手は、5つの分類基準の**いずれか1つでも**満たせば販売型リース（sales-type lease）に分類する。本問では2つが該当する。

- **経済的耐用年数テスト**: リース期間6年 ÷ 残存経済的耐用年数8年 = **75%** ≧ 75%（Exhibit 1の方針）→ 主要部分に該当
- **現在価値テスト**: $418,322 ÷ 公正価値 $420,000 = **99.6%** ≧ 90% → ほとんど全部に該当

所有権移転・割安購入オプション・特別仕様のいずれにも該当しないが、上記2つで十分。

直接金融リース（direct financing lease）になるのは、5基準のいずれも満たさず、かつ回収可能性が高く、**借手以外の第三者**が保証する残存価額を含めた現在価値が公正価値のほとんど全部になる場合に限られる。本問の保証は借手Calder自身によるものなので該当しない。基準を満たす以上オペレーティング・リースにもならず、6年のリース期間は短期リース（12か月以内）の要件も満たさない。

tasks.title: Lessor's Journal Entry at Commencement
tasks.instruction: Prepare the journal entry Meridian records on January 1, Year 1 to derecognize the sorting system and recognize the lease. Do not include the receipt of the January 1, Year 1 lease payment in this entry. Enter 0 in cells that should have no amount. Enter whole dollars, no commas.
tasks.explanation: At commencement of a sales-type lease, the lessor derecognizes the underlying asset and recognizes the net investment in the lease of $418,322. Because Meridian manufactured the asset, it also recognizes revenue and cost of sales. Sales revenue is the lower of the fair value of the underlying asset and the lease receivable, so it is the $418,322 lease receivable rather than the $420,000 fair value. Cost of goods sold is the $310,000 carrying amount of the sorting system reduced by any unguaranteed residual asset, and there is none here, so the full $310,000 is charged to cost of goods sold and the inventory account is credited for the same amount. The entry produces selling profit of $418,322 - $310,000 = $108,322 on the commencement date.
tasks.explanationJa:
販売型リースの開始日には、貸手は原資産の認識を中止し、正味リース投資未回収額を計上する。Meridianは自社製造品を貸与しているため、製造業者・販売業者としての売上高と売上原価も同時に認識する（初日利益）。

| 勘定 | 借方 | 貸方 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Net investment in the lease | 418,322 | |
| Cost of goods sold | 310,000 | |
| Sales revenue | | 418,322 |
| Equipment inventory | | 310,000 |

- **売上高**は「公正価値」と「リース債権」のいずれか**低い方**。ここではリース債権 $418,322 < 公正価値 $420,000 なので $418,322。
- **売上原価**は帳簿価額 $310,000 から無保証残存資産を控除した額。無保証残存はゼロなので $310,000 全額。
- 初日利益（selling profit）= $418,322 − $310,000 = **$108,322**。
- この仕訳には1月1日の受取リース料は含めない。受取時は借方 Cash 80,000 / 貸方 Net investment in the lease 80,000 を別に起票する。

tasks.title: Interest Income on the Lease for Year 1
tasks.instruction: Calculate the interest income that Meridian recognizes on the Calder Foods lease for the year ended December 31, Year 1. Enter the amount in whole dollars, no commas.
tasks.explanation: A lessor recognizes interest income on the net investment in the lease using the rate implicit in the lease. Because the $80,000 lease payments are due at the beginning of each lease year, the January 1, Year 1 payment is received on the commencement date and reduces the net investment before any interest accrues. Net investment after the first payment = $418,322 - $80,000 = $338,322. Interest income for Year 1 = $338,322 x 8% = $27,066. The net investment reported at December 31, Year 1 is therefore $338,322 + $27,066 = $365,388.
tasks.explanationJa:
貸手は、正味リース投資未回収額に対してリースの計算利子率を乗じて受取利息（リース収益）を認識する。

本問のリース料は**期首払い**なので、Year 1 開始日に受け取る $80,000 には利息が発生しない。

1. 初回受取後の残高 = $418,322 − $80,000 = **$338,322**
2. Year 1 の受取利息 = $338,322 × 8% = **$27,066**
3. 参考: Year 1 末の正味リース投資未回収額 = $338,322 + $27,066 = $365,388

期末払いと誤って $418,322 × 8% = $33,466 としないこと。支払時期の確認が分岐点になる。

tasks.title: Sale and Leaseback — Accounting Conclusion
tasks.instruction: Based on **Exhibit 4**, select the statement that correctly describes how Meridian accounts for the July 1, Year 1 warehouse transaction.
options: The transfer is a sale. Meridian derecognizes the warehouse and recognizes a $640,000 gain.
The transfer is a sale. Meridian derecognizes the warehouse and defers the $640,000 gain over the five-year leaseback term.
The transfer is not a sale. Meridian continues to recognize the warehouse and records a $3,000,000 financial liability.
The transfer is not a sale. Meridian derecognizes the warehouse and records a $3,000,000 financial liability.
tasks.correctAnswer: The transfer is not a sale. Meridian continues to recognize the warehouse and records a $3,000,000 financial liability.
tasks.explanation: When a seller-lessee holds a substantive option to repurchase the underlying asset, the transfer is not a sale unless both of two conditions are met: the exercise price of the option is the fair value of the asset at the time of exercise, and assets substantially the same as the transferred asset are readily available in the marketplace. Meridian's option is exercisable at the warehouse's then-current fair value, so the first condition is met, but Exhibit 4 states that assets substantially the same as the Fairview warehouse are not readily available. The second condition fails, Northgate Capital Partners does not obtain control, and the transfer is not a sale. In a failed sale and leaseback the seller-lessee does not derecognize the transferred asset, accounts for the amounts received as a financial liability of $3,000,000 under ASC 835-30, and recognizes no gain. Deferring and amortizing a gain is not a method available under ASC 842 in any event.
tasks.explanationJa:
セール&リースバックでは、まず**支配が買主兼貸手に移転して「売却」が成立するか**をASC 606の考え方で判定する。ここが最大の分岐点。

売却が否定される代表的な要因は2つ。

1. リースバックが売主兼借手にとってファイナンス・リース、または買主兼貸手にとって販売型リースに分類される場合（本問は該当しない）
2. **売主兼借手が実質的な買戻オプションを持つ場合** — この場合、次の(a)(b)を**両方**満たさない限り売却は成立しない。
   - (a) 行使価格が**行使時点の公正価値**であること → 本問は満たす
   - (b) 実質的に同一の代替資産が**市場で容易に入手可能**であること → 本問は倉庫という唯一無二の不動産であり**満たさない**

(b)を満たさないため支配は移転せず、売却は成立しない（failed sale and leaseback）。

その結果、
- 倉庫は**引き続きMeridianの資産として認識し続ける**（認識の中止をしない）
- 受取額 $3,000,000 の全額を**金融負債**として計上する
- 売却益 $3,000,000 − ($3,200,000 − $840,000) = $640,000 は**認識しない**

なお、ASC 842には売却益を繰り延べてリース期間で償却するという処理は存在しない。売却が成立する場合は利益を即時に全額認識する。

tasks.title: Seller-Lessee's Journal Entry on July 1, Year 1
tasks.instruction: Prepare the journal entry Meridian records on July 1, Year 1 for the Fairview warehouse transaction described in **Exhibit 4**. Enter 0 in cells that should have no amount. Enter whole dollars, no commas.
tasks.explanation: Because the transfer does not qualify as a sale, Meridian accounts for the transaction as a financing. It debits Cash for the $3,000,000 received and credits a financial liability for the same amount. The warehouse and its accumulated depreciation stay on Meridian's books at their existing amounts, so no entry is made to those accounts, and no gain is recognized. Meridian continues to depreciate the warehouse at $3,200,000 / 40 years = $80,000 per year, recording $40,000 for the six months ended December 31, Year 1 and reporting the warehouse at a net carrying amount of $2,360,000 - $40,000 = $2,320,000. Each $240,000 leaseback payment is split between interest expense on the financial liability and a reduction of that liability; none of it is rent expense.
tasks.explanationJa:
売却が成立しないため、この取引は**金融取引（借入）**として処理する。

| 勘定 | 借方 | 貸方 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cash | 3,000,000 | |
| Accumulated depreciation - warehouse | 0 | 0 |
| Warehouse | 0 | 0 |
| Financial liability | | 3,000,000 |
| Gain on sale of warehouse | 0 | 0 |

- 倉庫（取得原価 $3,200,000）と減価償却累計額 $840,000 は**帳簿にそのまま残る**ため、いずれの行にも金額は入らない。
- 売却益 $640,000 は**認識しない**。
- 受取額 $3,000,000 の全額を金融負債に計上する。

その後の処理:
- 減価償却は継続する。$3,200,000 ÷ 40年 = 年 $80,000。7月1日から12月31日までの6か月分 $40,000 を計上し、Year 1 末の倉庫の帳簿価額は $2,360,000 − $40,000 = **$2,320,000**。
- リースバック料 $240,000 は支払賃借料（rent expense）ではなく、**金融負債に対する支払利息と元本返済**に配分する。

tasks.title: Research — Repurchase Option in a Sale and Leaseback
tasks.instruction: Meridian's audit committee asks for the authoritative support for the conclusion reached on the Fairview warehouse. Which paragraph of the FASB Accounting Standards Codification states the conditions that must be met for a seller-lessee's repurchase option not to preclude the transfer of the asset from being accounted for as a sale? Cite the ASC reference in XXX-XX-XX-XX format.
tasks.explanation: ASC 842-40-25-3 provides that when a seller-lessee has a substantive repurchase option for the underlying asset, the transfer of the asset is not a sale unless both the exercise price of the option is the fair value of the asset at the time of exercise and there are alternative assets, substantially the same as the transferred asset, readily available in the marketplace. ASC 842-40-25-2 addresses the separate condition that a leaseback classified as a finance lease by the seller-lessee or a sales-type lease by the buyer-lessor also prevents sale accounting.
tasks.explanationJa:
**ASC 842-40-25-3** が該当する。買戻オプションがある場合、次の(a)(b)を両方満たさない限り資産の移転は売却として処理できないと定めている。

- (a) オプションの行使価格が、行使時点における当該資産の公正価値であること
- (b) 当該資産と実質的に同一の代替資産が、市場で容易に入手可能であること

本問の倉庫は(b)を満たさないため売却は成立しない。

近接する条文との切り分け:
- ASC 842-40-25-2: リースバックが売主兼借手にとってファイナンス・リース、買主兼貸手にとって販売型リースに分類される場合は売却ではない、という別要件を定める条文
- ASC 842-40-25-5: 売却が成立しなかった場合の会計処理（資産の認識継続・金融負債の計上）を定める条文
